profile_text.body:
Seagate Technology Holdings plc is a public company headquartered in Singapore and traded under the ticker STX. Its website describes it as a leader in mass-capacity data storage, and states that it has delivered more than four billion terabytes of capacity over the past four decades. The company says it makes storage that scales and that it brings trust and integrity to innovations that depend on data.

On AI, Seagate says it is optimizing storage for AI and making capacity leaps intended to support efficient data center architecture and buildout. It frames the opportunity around the volume of data that people and machines will create as AI proliferates, and points to strategic shifts meant to close the gap between AI's growing data demands and infrastructure readiness. The company's SEC filing identifier is CIK 0001137789. No products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are recorded for it.
